_arch_note_0214: MARGIN-READOUT CELL (task 980c04e8). FORK of exp_g_0207 (the full-rank-compress n=1 control, 1.131286). The ONLY change is lut_cell_mode 'constant'->'margin_readout' (+ lut_margin_signed=true). Geometry is byte-identical to 0207: H=8, tph=64, nap=8, d_in=d_out=48, full-rank compress (H*d_in=384=d_model), read_top_n=1, pair-difference addressing, margin confidence, no z_norm. THE CELL: instead of each cell storing only a constant vector v_c that the table reads out (y = s_t * v_c), the cell now emits an AFFINE function of the signed anchor margins: y_t = v_c + W_t * m, where v_c is the per-cell constant store (the ordinary table, bagged as today), W_t is a per-TABLE learnable matrix [d_out, nap] shared across that table's cells, and m = the SIGNED margins d_j = x[a_j]-x[b_j] (NOT |d_j|; margin_signed=true). Factorizes into two adds: term1 = the constant bagged read-out (unchanged), term2 = sum_t score_t * (W_t . m_t) via einsum. RATIONALE: the constant-cell LUT throws away the WITHIN-cell position of x -- every token landing in a cell gets the identical row. margin_readout lets the output vary linearly with how far x sits from each hyperplane, a first-order within-cell correction, the cheapest step up from piecewise-constant toward the dense MLP's smoothness. Compare vs 0207 (same geometry, constant cell = 1.131286) and vs gated_affine 0213 (the other within-cell lever, 1.128507) and dense@48K 1.115420 (sigma=0.00335). PARAM COUNT: 0207's 68,237,574 + the W_t tensors. W_t is [n_tables, d_out, nap] = [512, 48, 8] per layer = 196,608 params/layer * 6 layers = 1,179,648, so expect ~69,417,222 total -- VERIFY against the gate print, do not assume. W_t init small (rand-0.5)*2*init_weights_noise so training starts within sigma of the 0207 constant-cell baseline. read_top_n=1 (margin cell is n=1-only by construction; the blend path raises). Corrected eval bs48x100 skip12, optimized LightMHL. Seed 1, lut_base_seed 1000, tables_no_decay. ORIG-0207-NOTE follows.
